messages:
Ben C: Heads up — seeing a spike in 502/504s for new-tenant onboarding API flows starting ~09:12 PT. Impact looks concentrated on webhook auth and initial embed syncs. ~30 tenants flagged, some in trial. Can ops/eng confirm scope?
Emily R: Confirmed on my side, got 5 support tickets so far from trial accounts. Users report timeouts when connecting repo and failing final step.
SRE Bot: Alert: [INC-20240423-99] 09:14 PT — 502 up: onboarding-webhooks-service error rate 18% (baseline 0.5%).
Raj P: Looking at logs — auth service returning `upstream read timeout` from idp-proxy layer. Rolling a small config rollback to previous nginx timeout now to test.
Ben C: Thanks Raj. CS needs an interim customer-facing update. Suggest short note: acknowledge issue, reconciliation ETA, and invite to office hours. Also offer scoped credits for affected trials. Thoughts?
Olivia M: I can draft an email. Prefer to call it an "interim status" rather than full RCA. Quick Q: do we want to send to all flagged tenants or only those who filed tickets?
Emily R: Send to all flagged tenants (30). Some haven't raised tickets yet but are at high churn risk. Keep message short and link to office hours.
Raj P: Rollback done 09:27 PT. Error rate dropped to 2% and continuing to trend down. Still monitoring for any regressions.
SRE Bot: Event: config.rollback by raj@infra at 09:27 PT.
Ben C: Great. Olivia — draft should include: 1) what happened (high-level), 2) impact list (what failed), 3) mitigation taken, 4) immediate next steps (monitoring + office hours), 5) how to get help (support link + direct rep). Add credit offer line: "we'll apply a trial-day credit for interruptions".
Olivia M: Draft ready in #docs-drafts, posting in 5. Will personalize subject lines for trials.
Emily R: I'll queue targeted outbound: phone for top 5 trials in risk cohort, email for the rest. Add a note to indicate we’ll follow up with RCA.
Raj P: Monitoring looks stable 09:41 PT, error rate ~0.6%. Will keep watch for 2 hours then mark resolved if stable.
Ben C: Set up a 30-min office hours at 11:00 PT for impacted customers — Olivia can host with Raj on standby. Emily will moderate reps. Add calendar invite and link to the email.
Olivia M: Invite sent, office-hours link in draft. Draft copy pasted below for visibility:
---
Hi — we wanted to let you know that earlier today we saw elevated timeouts impacting onboarding flows for a subset of tenants. Our team identified an upstream timeout config change and reverted it; services are recovering and we continue to monitor.
What we changed: rolled back a recent nginx timeout tweak for the webhook/auth proxy.
Impact: customers may have experienced failures when completing repo/webhook setup or initial embedding syncs.
What we’re doing now: monitoring for stability, offering a 1-day trial credit to affected trial tenants, and hosting office hours at 11:00 PT to answer questions.
How to reach us: reply to this email or open a support ticket at https://support.redwood.ai and mention INC-20240423-99.
We’ll follow up with a full RCA once validated.
---
Ben C: Looks good — add clear subject: "Interim update: onboarding interruptions (Apr 23)" and include a tiny TL;DR at top.
Olivia M: Updated. Will send at :30 once legal okays the credit text. Tagging @legal for quick review.
Emily R: I'll prepare the outbound list and scripts for reps. Also logging which tenants get phone vs email outreach.
Raj P: Note for RCA: root cause appears to be a config mismatch pushed during rollout that decreased upstream read timeouts too aggressively. Will collect timeline and playbook notes after stabilization.
Ben C: Thanks team. Action owners: Olivia — send interim email once legal ok (target +30m). Emily — outbound list + calls for top-5. Raj — compile timeline & keep monitoring. SRE Bot will post final status.
SRE Bot: Monitoring check-in scheduled in 30m.
Emily R: Also capturing customer feedback in the follow-up survey post-office-hours.
Ben C: Good. We'll reconvene in #customer-success at 10:45 PT for send OK or hold. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
